steps.hardClue: Activate the artifact, collect the bridle and ride to the underworld.
steps.clue: Activate the Sentinel Artifact, obtain the Golden Bridle and ride Pegasus to Dark Delphi.

steps.hardClue: Free the two caged birds, then survive the lockdown at the center of the underworld.
steps.clue: Free the two caged eagles and survive the Center of the World lockdown to unlock Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Ignite the shield’s spear, then light the three oil spills around the map.
steps.clue: Light Apollo’s Will with the Eternal Flame, then ignite the three oil spills around the map.

steps.hardClue: Stand in the charged pool and shoot the four statues with glowing eyes.
steps.clue: Stand in a Redeemed Hand of Charon shot and shoot the four statues with glowing blue eyes.

steps.hardClue: Synchronize three hidden cog sets, then turn the three rotating statues inward.
steps.clue: Use Apollo’s Will to synchronize the three hidden cog sets, then turn the three statues inward.

steps.hardClue: Complete the symbol puzzle, solve the sundial and defend the statue’s beam.
steps.clue: Complete the Danu symbol puzzle, solve the sundial and defend Ra to recover his Scepter.

steps.hardClue: Stand on the matching colored circles and kill the corresponding enemies across three phases.
steps.clue: Complete the three-phase Amphitheater shooting challenge using the Hands of God.

steps.hardClue: Shoot six symbols on the hidden door in the correct order.
steps.clue: Shoot the six symbols on the River of Sorrow door in the correct order.

steps.hardClue: Place the special equipment on the blue circle to raise the siege weapon.
steps.clue: Place the Pegasus Strike on the blue circle to raise the Ballista.

steps.hardClue: Aim the siege weapon with the wind weapon, then coat the spear in acid and fire at the serpent.
steps.clue: Aim the Ballista with the Redeemed Hand of Ouranos, coat Apollo’s Will in acid and fire at the Python.

steps.hardClue: Enter the portal and defeat the winged creature, then the demigod.
steps.clue: Enter the portal and defeat Pegasus, then Perseus.
